desc:
CAKE MIX: Bake a delicious, moist strawberry cake dessert

QUICK AND EASY: Make a cake by just adding a few simple ingredients as directed and popping in the oven

ENDLESS OPTIONS: Add your own twist to these mixes by using as cupcake mix or trying tested and trusted Betty Crocker recipes

DELICIOUS & SPONGY: Enjoy the sweetness of this versatile cake mix and make it your own; Bake strawberry cake mix for sweet celebrations and everyday moments

CONTAINS: 13.25 oz
features:
Features

Sweet Strawberry Flavor

Delivers a bright, fruity strawberry taste perfect for summer desserts, birthdays, or pink-themed celebrations.

Super Moist Texture

Specially formulated to produce a soft, tender crumb that stays moist after baking.

Easy Preparation

Just add water, oil, and eggs—mix and bake for foolproof results every time.

Versatile Use

Can be baked as a sheet cake, layered cake, or cupcakes—perfect for any occasion.

Generous Size

Makes one 13x9" cake or up to 24 cupcakes.

Colorful & Fun Presentation

Bakes into a lovely pink color that’s visually appealing, especially for kids and themed parties.

Supports Box Tops for Education

Eligible for Box Tops program, helping contribute to school fundraising efforts.

Quality Ingredients

Made with enriched flour, sugar, leavening agents, stabilizers, artificial and natural strawberry flavor, and red food coloring.

Allergen Information

Contains wheat; may contain milk and soy ingredients.

Benefits

Quick Homemade Delight

Enjoy bakery-style strawberry cake at home without the need for scratch baking.

Perfect for Parties & Themed Events

A go-to option for baby showers, birthday parties, Valentine’s Day, or any fun gathering.

Kid-Friendly

The flavor and color are both popular with children—great for cupcakes or cake pops.

Creative Customization

Works well with cream cheese frosting, whipped cream, fruit toppings, or chocolate drizzle.

Consistent Results

Trusted for its even rise, moist texture, and rich flavor—batch after batch.

Great Value

Affordable option for making delicious, crowd-pleasing desserts at home.
ingredients: Enriched Flour Bleached (wheat flour, niacin, iron, thiamin mononitrate, riboflavin, folic acid), Sugar, Corn Syrup, Leavening (baking soda, sodium aluminum phosphate, monocalcium phosphate). Contains 2% or less of: Modified Corn Starch, Corn Starch, Propylene Glycol Mono and Diesters, Salt, Monoglycerides, Palm Oil, Dicalcium Phosphate, Sodium Stearoyl Lactylate, Xanthan Gum, Cellulose Gum, Natural and Artificial Flavor, Red 40.
